text:
maya: Opening PR to reconcile dashboard prefetch docs + tracehook param names. Found cost/latency graph labels inconsistent between Node and Python snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 :link:

sam: Nice — can you add a tiny example for prefix KV prefetch config? Users hit high tail latency when prefetch=0.5 -> they expect warm-cache behavior.

maya: Yup adding Python + Rust snippets. Quick draft:
```python
# prefetch config
console.set_prefetch(kv_prefix='session:', ratio=0.5)
```

jon: Two quick asks: (1) confirm metric name is `redwood.kv.cache.prefetch_hit_rate` not `kv_prefetch.hit_rate`, (2) add note about effect on billing (tokens per cache miss).

maya: @jon good catch — will rename metric references. Also adding cost note: 'cache warmups may increase token count for first request in a window'.

docs-bot: Automated checks: link-checker failed on docs image URL -> https://docs.redwood.ai/images/kvcache.png  (404).

eva: I can reupload the image to the static CDN, or swap to an embedded SVG. Reupload sounds quicker.

sam: :eyes: Also check the tracing hook example — the `trace_id` field casing mismatch in the Node snippet was causing flaky linking to console traces.

maya: I'll push a fix in the PR tonight. Tagging @release to avoid cutting the docs branch until after merge. ETA EOD PST.

release: noted. please include changelog line 'docs: kv prefetch + tracehook parity fixes' and a regression test entry.

maya: :shipit: PR updated, added note in migration guide and small regression test in docs/ci that runs snippet rendering. Anyone wanna quick review? cc: @eva @jon

jon: LGTM apart from one nit in Rust snippet — use `prefetch_ratio` not `ratio`.

eva: I'll review images and approve after CI passes.
